description: This file defines a static class WindowsElementExtensions with an extension method WaitForDisplayed for WindowsElement objects, used in UI test automation to wait until an element is visible or timeout occurs.

classes.name: WindowsElementExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for WindowsElement, specifically to wait until the element is displayed.

methods.name: WaitForDisplayed
methods.description: An extension method that waits for a WindowsElement to be displayed within a specified timeout period, polling every 10ms.
